name: Valentina Carrasco
bio:
Valentina's career in motorsport began almost by accident. Fresh out of university with a degree in industrial engineering, she took a job at a Santiago-based logistics firm. One of their clients was a small rally team, and Valentina quickly proved adept at navigating the complex world of international shipping and customs. Her efficiency and problem-solving skills caught the eye of the Hitech Development team principal, who recruited her to streamline their logistics operations.

Now, Valentina is the backbone of Hitech's racing efforts. She thrives on the fast-paced environment and the constant challenge of ensuring equipment and personnel arrive on time and within budget. Her meticulous planning and calm demeanor under pressure have earned her the respect of the entire team. What sets Valentina apart is her creative approach to problem-solving; she's known for finding innovative solutions to logistical bottlenecks, often saving the team valuable time and money.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Valentina is a slender woman with a focused expression and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with logistical charts and schedules.
Insists on using a specific Chilean brand of coffee, which she brews herself in the office.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
